label: WebKit (Playwright)
description: Local: drives the Playwright-managed WebKit build. No key, no service.

errors.notFound: web_search: no Playwright installation to drive {Browser} — install the Playwright MCP (npx @playwright/mcp) so its managed browsers are available.
errors.notInstalled: web_search: the managed {Browser} build is not installed — run `npx playwright install {browser}`, then retry.
errors.launchFailed: web_search: the managed {Browser} browser failed to launch ({message}) — try again, or pick {alternative} in Settings (General page).
errors.cannotReach: web_search: {Browser} could not reach the search page ({message}) — check your network or proxy, then retry.
errors.timeout: web_search: {Browser} timed out after {ms}ms waiting for {Serp} search results — retry, or pick {alternative} in Settings (General page).
errors.blocked: web_search: {Browser} reached {Serp} but it yielded no parseable results ({chars} chars) — retry, or pick {alternative} in Settings (General page).
errors.mismatched: web_search: {Serp} returned a search page that answers a different query (top hit: "{first}") — retry, or pick {alternative} in Settings (General page).
